items.q: And the fact of the matter is we won an amateur contest together in one of the local theatres.

ctx.x: And the fact of the matter is we won an amateur contest together in one of the local theatres. The irony of this particular story also is it was hardly able to tell which one of us was oldest because I was -- he and I were about the same size. He was about 12 or 14, I was 16. So no one really knew.
